welcome.title: Learn With Clarity
welcome.content: This page brings together everything you need to move through the lesson: video, activities, questions, and support from SofLIA.

header.title: Course Header
header.content: Here you can see the course name, go back to the previous screen, and restart this tour whenever you need it.

progress.title: Your Progress
progress.content: This indicator summarizes your course progress so you always know how much you have completed.

sidebar.title: Course Content
sidebar.content: Use this panel to move through modules, lessons, materials, and notes without leaving the learning experience.

moduleProgress.title: Module Progress
moduleProgress.content: These labels show how many lessons you have completed in the module and the percentage reached.

currentLesson.title: Current Lesson
currentLesson.content: The highlighted lesson marks where you are. You can switch topics from the list whenever you want to continue elsewhere.

tabs.title: Work Modes
tabs.content: Switch between video, activities, and questions depending on what you want to do right now.

video.title: Lesson Video
video.content: Play the main content, control your progress, and use the built-in navigation to move between lessons.

resources.title: Transcript and Summary
resources.content: Review the full text or the lesson summary and turn them into notes for later study.

activitiesTab.title: Activities
activitiesTab.content: Open this tab to practice what you learned, review materials, and complete exercises when they are available.

activities.title: Guided Practice
activities.content: This section shows the lesson activities and supporting materials. If there is no content yet, you will see the matching empty state.

questionsTab.title: Questions
questionsTab.content: Open this area to review course questions or start a conversation with other participants.

questions.title: Course Conversations
questions.content: Search existing questions or create a new one to resolve doubts about the lesson.

sofliaPanel.title: SofLIA Panel
sofliaPanel.content: When SofLIA is open, this is where suggestions, answers, and the lesson question field appear.

soflia.title: Your SofLIA Assistant
soflia.content: SofLIA helps you clarify concepts, generate notes, and connect the content with your course progress.

welcome.title: Welcome to your panel
welcome.content: Here you can find your learning paths, assigned courses, and key shortcuts to keep learning.

topNav.title: Top Bar
topNav.content: This area confirms the active organization and keeps your main panel shortcuts close at hand.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.content: Check updates about courses, activities, and important changes so you can stay on track.

accountMenu.title: Your Account
accountMenu.content: Open your profile, statistics, certificates, language, and other personal options from here.

hero.title: Panel Overview
hero.content: The greeting places you in your learning space and summarizes the purpose of this view.

coursesHeader.title: Your Courses
coursesHeader.content: This section brings together learning paths and standalone courses assigned to your account.

viewToggle.title: Course View
viewToggle.content: Switch between grid and list view to review your courses in the format that works best for you.

learningPath.title: Learning Path
learningPath.content: Paths organize courses by priority. Complete each step to unlock or continue the next one.

introVideo.title: Intro Video
introVideo.content: Play this video to understand the goal of the path before you start or continue.

courseRail.title: Course Carousel
courseRail.content: Move through the path to see available, locked, and completed courses in order.

courseCard.title: Course Card
courseCard.content: Each card shows the cover, progress, status, and entry point for the course content.

certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.content: When you complete a course with a certificate, this shortcut lets you open it quickly.

standalone.title: Standalone Courses
standalone.content: Courses assigned outside a path appear here with their own progress and status.

soflia.title: Your SofLIA Assistant
soflia.content: SofLIA can help with questions about your courses, progress, or next steps whenever you need it.

welcome.title: Business Panel
welcome.content: This panel brings together your organization's overall status, key shortcuts, and recent team activity.

topNav.title: Top Bar
topNav.content: Confirm the active organization here and quickly reach notifications and account options.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.content: Review important updates about users, courses, and follow-up events across your organization.

accountMenu.title: Account Menu
accountMenu.content: Use your avatar to switch panels, edit your profile, adjust language, review certificates, or sign out.

sidebar.title: Side Navigation
sidebar.content: Use this menu to move through users, courses, paths, structure, reports, reviews, and settings.

sidebarCollapse.title: Adjust Menu
sidebarCollapse.content: Collapse or expand the sidebar to gain workspace without losing the main navigation.

hero.title: Opening Summary
hero.content: The header gives you panel context, greets the administrator, and shows the current work date.

relaunch.title: Guided Tour
relaunch.content: Use this button to relaunch the panel walkthrough whenever you need to locate its main functions.

stats.title: General Metrics
stats.content: These cards show active users, assigned courses, completions, progress, certificates, engagement, and invitations.

quickActions.title: Quick Actions
quickActions.content: Jump straight into frequent tasks such as managing users, assigning courses, opening reports, or configuring the organization.

recentActivity.title: Recent Activity
recentActivity.content: Check the latest team movements to spot progress, changes, or relevant pending work.

soflia.title: Your SofLIA Assistant
soflia.content: SofLIA can support you with panel questions, courses, team progress, or next management steps.

hero.title: User Management
hero.content: Manage all of your organization's members from here: active users, sent invitations, access links, and pending join requests.

stats.title: Team Overview
stats.content: These cards show the total number of users, how many are active, how many have pending invitations, how many are administrators, and the join requests received.

filters.title: Search and Filter
filters.content: Use the tabs to switch between users, invitations, links, and requests. Apply filters by role, status, region, zone, or team to find exactly who you need.

list.title: User List
list.content: Users from the active tab appear here. Click a user to view their profile, change their role, or manage their access to courses and learning paths.

actions.title: Management Actions
actions.content: From these buttons you can refresh the list, export or bulk-import users, send individual invitations, or create a new user directly.

soflia.title: Your SofLIA Assistant
soflia.content: SofLIA can help you understand your team's status, suggest how to structure invitations, and answer questions about user management.

header.title: Structure Management
header.content: Define how your company is organized here: regions, zones, and teams that group your employees for reporting and course assignments.

tabs.title: Panel Views
tabs.content: Use the Tree tab to visualize and manage your hierarchy, or Settings to enable and customize the organization structure.

structureSelector.title: Structure Selector
structureSelector.content: If you have multiple active structures, this selector lets you switch between them to view or edit the one you need.

actions.title: Manage Your Team
actions.content: Add members directly to the root structure or create a new structure to segment your organization differently.

treeBody.title: Hierarchy Tree
treeBody.content: This tree shows regions, zones, and teams in cascade. Expand nodes, rename levels, add sub-levels, or remove branches you no longer need.

soflia.title: Your SofLIA Assistant
soflia.content: SofLIA can help you configure your organization structure and understand how it affects learning path and course assignments.

hero.title: Course Catalog
hero.content: This panel shows all courses available to your organization. From here you can explore them, assign them to your team, and track progress.

stats.title: Catalog Metrics
stats.content: These cards summarize the total courses, available categories, difficulty levels, and total number of enrolled students in your organization.

filters.title: Search and Filter
filters.content: Type a name, instructor, or description to locate courses quickly, or apply filters by category and difficulty level.

viewToggle.title: Catalog View
viewToggle.content: Switch between grid view for visual exploration or list view for faster comparison and search.

grid.title: Available Courses
grid.content: Each card shows the cover, title, category, level, and instructor. Click any course to see its full detail and assignment options.

firstCard.title: Ready to Explore!
firstCard.content: Close the tour with Got it! and then click any course to see its full detail: content, reviews, instructor, and the option to assign it to your team.

hero.title: Course Overview
hero.content: This header summarizes the essentials: cover, title, category, level, duration, and instructor — giving you quick context before diving in.

tabsContainer.title: Course Sections
tabsContainer.content: Browse General Information, Module Content, User Reviews, and Instructor tabs to fully understand the course before assigning it.

sidebar.title: Assign and Acquire
sidebar.content: From this sidebar you can assign the course to team members or manage it based on availability and your organization's permissions.

soflia.title: Your SofLIA Assistant
soflia.content: SofLIA can help you decide if this course is right for your team and suggest how to structure the assignment.

hero.title: Reports and Analytics Hub
hero.content: This panel centralizes all key metrics for your organization. From here you can export data, generate AI-powered analyses, and apply filters by period, area, role, or team to explore specific results.

filters.title: Analysis Filters
filters.content: Set the analysis period using start and end dates. Filter by area, role, region, zone, or team. All report panels update in real time with every filter change you apply here.

kpi.title: Executive KPIs
kpi.content: The top cards show the most critical indicators at a glance: total assigned users, how many are active, the organization's average progress, course completion rate, overall compliance, and users at risk. Think of them as the quick health check for your training program.

workforce.title: Workforce Status
workforce.content: This donut chart shows the actual distribution of your team by learning stage: Not started, In progress, Advancing, and Completed. The numbers reflect real headcount, not estimates. Use it to immediately see how many employees have not yet begun their training.

radar.title: Organizational Health Profile
radar.content: The radar evaluates your organization across six dimensions at once: Activity (active platform use), Progress (average course advancement), Compliance (completion vs. target), Academic quality (assessment performance), SofLIA (AI assistant adoption), and Planning (study planner use). The dotted line marks the 70% target. The fuller the radar, the healthier your organization.

compliance.title: Compliance by Area
compliance.content: This horizontal bar chart shows the course completion rate broken down by area or department. It is the most actionable view for HR: instantly spot which areas are below target and need intervention. Click a bar to filter the entire report by that area.

riskUsers.title: Users at Risk
riskUsers.content: This table lists employees with the highest likelihood of dropping out, ordered by risk level (High, Medium). For each user you see their area, assigned courses, current progress, days without activity, and the detected risk cause. Use it to prioritize direct outreach before a user disengages entirely.

funnel.title: Learning Funnel
funnel.content: The funnel shows where progress is lost on the path to completion. Left to right: Assigned → Started → Over 25% → Over 50% → Over 75% → Completed. The red percentage shows the drop between stages. Identify which step has the highest dropout rate so you can focus follow-up actions there.

courseRisk.title: Courses with Operational Risk
courseRisk.content: This table orders courses by their composite operational risk, considering the number assigned, how many are active, average progress, completion rate, pending deadlines, and the overall risk signal. Red courses need immediate attention: they may have approaching deadlines or very low adherence.

scatter.title: Team Positioning Map
scatter.content: Each bubble represents a team. The X axis shows average progress and the Y axis shows the completion rate. Bubble size indicates the number of users on the team. Teams in the upper-right quadrant are healthy; those in red in the lower-left need urgent attention. Switch between Teams, Regions, and Zones using the tabs.

ranking.title: Performance Ranking
ranking.content: Ranks users, teams, regions, and zones by a composite score combining progress, completion, academic quality, and tool adoption. Use the tabs to switch views. Top performers have practices worth identifying and sharing; those at the bottom may need additional support.

segments.title: Performance by Segment
segments.content: Compares training performance across Teams, Roles, Regions, and Zones. For each segment you see the number of users, average progress, completion rate, and pending deadlines. This is the key tool for spotting training gaps between groups and deciding where to concentrate development efforts.

trend.title: Learning Evolution
trend.content: This line chart shows how the number of completed courses has evolved over time, week by week. Identify activity peaks (perhaps after a reminder campaign), periods of sustained decline, or continuous improvement trends. Use it to correlate management actions with real results.

academic.title: Academic Performance
academic.content: The four cards show learning quality for the filtered period: Assessment average (quiz scores), Pass rate (percentage of passed assessments), Completed activities (finished exercises), and Pending activities. A high assessment average with low completion rate signals an adherence problem, not a comprehension one.

sofliaQuality.title: SofLIA Quality and Interaction
sofliaQuality.content: Measures how your team uses the AI assistant. You will see: active users with SofLIA, total conversations, messages per session, and resolution rate. Below, response quality breaks down question types (general, course, support). Usage by context shows where SofLIA is consulted most: general, course, or planner.

planner.title: Study Planner
planner.content: Analyzes your team's adherence to the study plan generated by SofLIA. You can see how many sessions were scheduled vs. completed, time variance (difference between planned and actual), and the percentage of users who actively use the planner. Low adherence may indicate unrealistic plans or a lack of follow-through.

notes.title: Notes and Summaries
notes.content: Shows notebook adoption: total notes created, users with at least one note, and overall adoption rate. The chart distinguishes between auto-generated notes (created by SofLIA at lesson end) and manual ones (written by the user). A high proportion of manual notes indicates active engagement with learning.

insights.title: AI-Powered Smart Analysis
insights.content: SofLIA analyzes all report data and generates an executive report with key findings, detected risk patterns, and prioritized actionable recommendations. Click Analyze with AI and wait a few seconds. When ready, you can export it as a PDF to share with your leadership or HR team.

header.title: Course Reviews
header.content: This panel centralizes the courses that need your approval before becoming available to organization users. Here you manage the approval, rejection, and update tracking workflow for all content.

stats.title: Review Status
stats.content: These cards show how many courses are pending review, how many were rejected, how many have recent updates available, and how many are new content that has not yet been evaluated.

filters.title: Filter and Search Courses
filters.content: Use the tabs to switch between Pending, Rejected, Updates, and New. The search field lets you find a specific course by name within the active tab.

grid.title: Courses to Review
grid.content: Each card shows the cover, title, category, and available actions based on the course status. You can approve a course to make it available in the organization, reject it with a comment, or open it to review its content in detail before deciding.

soflia.title: Your SofLIA Assistant
soflia.content: SofLIA can help you evaluate whether a course is suitable for your team, compare options, and draft clear, constructive rejection comments.

hero.title: Organization Settings
hero.content: Manage all of your organization's configuration in one place: name, language, time zone, SofLIA context, and visual customization. Changes apply immediately for all users in the organization.

tabs.title: Settings Sections
tabs.content: The Organization tab covers general data: basic information, contact details, the context SofLIA will use to answer your team, and access options. The Branding tab (Enterprise plan) lets you customize the logo, favicon, and platform colors to reflect your company's visual identity.

soflia.title: Your SofLIA Assistant
soflia.content: SofLIA can help you write the organizational context, suggest settings based on your company type, and answer questions about which options affect end users.

hero.title: Learning Paths
hero.content: Learning paths group courses in a defined order to guide your team through a complete, progressive training process.

stats.title: Path Metrics
stats.content: See how many paths are active, how many workshops they include, how many users have them assigned, and the total active assignments.

search.title: Search a Path
search.content: Type a path name to quickly find it in the catalog and access its details or assignment options.

cards.title: Path Catalog
cards.content: Each card shows the name, description, included courses, and options to manage and assign the path to your team.

assignments.title: Active Assignments
assignments.content: This section lists which users or groups have each path assigned, with the assignment date and current progress status.

soflia.title: Your SofLIA Assistant
soflia.content: SofLIA can help you design training paths, understand your team's progress, and suggest the optimal course order.
